sourceDescription: Welcome to {Border Village/Yellow} Young traveller.
Before you get started with your journey
would you please do me a quick favour?
description: 年轻的旅者,欢迎来到{边界村/Yellow}
在开始你的旅途之前,能否先帮我个小忙?
taskDescription: 把{食人花叶/LightSteelBlue}捎给{工艺夫人/LimeGreen}.

sourceDescription: Could you do a favour for me as well? I want to
give a present to {Jane/LimeGreen} to show my gratitude.
But i cannot leave here at the moment.
description: 能帮我个忙吗?我想送一份礼物给{周慧/LimeGreen}以表达
我的感激之情,但这会儿我实在是忙的不可开交.
taskDescription: 在{稻草人/Crimson}身上找到{姜茶/LightSteelBlue}带给{边界村/Yellow}的{Assistant 周慧/LimeGreen}.

sourceDescription: Hello traveller..
{Butcher John/LimeGreen} is loooking for some help.
I think its an urgent matter.
description: 你好,旅行者.
我听说{Butcher 吴华/LimeGreen}正在寻求帮助.
我想他一定是遇上麻烦事了.
taskDescription: 在坐标293:603附近找到{Butcher 吴华/LimeGreen}.

sourceDescription: You are the traveller {Jane/LimeGreen} recommended.
Please can you hunt {Deer/Crimson} and bring me some
{Deer Meat/LightSteelBlue}. If you want to know more about
butchering please press "H".
description: 啊,你就是{周慧/LimeGreen}提到的冒险家吗.
你能帮我猎几头{鹿/Crimson}并带回一些{鹿肉/LightSteelBlue}吗?
如果你想了解更多关于屠夫的帮助,请按"H"键.
taskDescription: 猎杀{鹿/Crimson}并收集5块{鹿肉/LightSteelBlue}.

sourceDescription: Young traveller my name is {Smith/LimeGreen}.
There are so my monsters outside the village
I don't know how I'll make it to {BichonWall/Yellow}
Can you help me?
description: 年轻的冒险者,我的名字叫{陈安/LimeGreen}.
现在村外的怪物太泛滥,我都不敢去{比奇城/Yellow}了.
你能帮我消灭一些怪物吗?
taskDescription: 消灭5只{鹿/Crimson}和5只{稻草人/Crimson}.

sourceDescription: 旅行者……我还是觉得外面太危险了。
你能再帮我一个忙吗？
description: 冒险家...我还是觉得外面太危险了.
你能再帮我个忙吗?
taskDescription: 消灭5只{多钩猫/Crimson}

sourceDescription: Hello young traveller. Have you heard
of the Warrior Instructor in this region?
He is the master of all Warriors. I hear
hes been looking for a new disciple lately.

他是这片大陆上所有职业战士的领袖.

I can't reject anyone that she has recommended,
but I cant accept just anyone as my disciple.
You will have to pass my test.

但也不是随便来个阿猫阿狗就能成为我的弟子.
你能通过我的试炼再说吧.

taskDescription: 与坐标335:275附近的{MirGuide 王欣/LimeGreen}交谈.

Archer Captain Currently protecting the

你一定听说了最近在保护这一带的安全
的“弓箭手队长”了吧?
有传言说他为了支援战争正在招收门徒.
taskDescription: 与坐标320:476附近的{HighTaoist/LimeGreen}交谈.

We need all that is able to help with this war.
Whether they join the Guard or not.
Please can you assist me with something.
description: 一名被推荐的人?当然这只是第一步.
我们要的是能对这场战争有帮助的人.
不是随便来个阿猫阿狗都能加入战斗的.
请先证明你自己吧.
taskDescription: 消灭5个{Oma/Crimson}和5个{RakingCat/Crimson}.

I have asked {Peter/LimeGreen} to give you some work

description: 现在你终于看起来像个训练有素的弓箭手了.
我已经让{MirGuide 王欣/LimeGreen}给你安排了一些活儿.
去吧,好好干,他不会亏待你的.
taskDescription: 与坐标335:275附近的{MirGuide 王欣/LimeGreen}交谈.

sourceDescription: I've been getting reports that {ForestYeti's/Crimson} are
attacking only the new Warrior's lately.
Do you think you can help?
description: 最近我接到报告,附近的{森林雪人/Crimson}
专挑新人勇士攻击.你认为你真的ok吗?
taskDescription: 消灭5个{森林雪人/Crimson}.

sourceDescription: There are creatures named {Oma/Crimson} outside
{BichonWall/Yellow} and other towns.
They are very strong and violent. They have
been attacking the merchants. Hey, would you
be able to help us eliminate the danager?
description: 最近{比奇城/Yellow}和周边村庄附近
出现了一些叫做{半兽人/Crimson}的怪物.
他们非常强壮残忍,并且不断的袭击往来的商队,
你能帮我们消除威胁吗?
taskDescription: 请消灭一些{半兽人/Crimson}并带回5个{兽人牙齿/LightSteelBlue}.

sourceDescription: {Blacksmith Jang/LimeGreen}, has requested some help.
Please can you go speak to him he is located
in {WoomyonWoods/Yellow} If you follow the path North
it will lead you to {WoomyonWoods/Yellow} town.
description: {Blacksmith 周涛/LimeGreen}需要一些帮助.
他住在{沃玛森林/Yellow}的北方,你可以顺着城西北的
小路一路向北,就能到达{沃玛村/Yellow}.
请你去帮帮他好吗?
taskDescription: 前往{沃玛森林/Yellow}找到{周涛/LimeGreen}并和他谈谈.

sourceDescription: Hello traveller. Thankyou for coming.
The reason I asked for you was to get some
help keeping {WoomyonWoods/Yellow} safe. You
probably have seen some {CannibalPlant's/Crimson}
on the way here from {BichonWall/Yellow}. We need
to hunt them down to keep merchants safe
from dangerous attacks.
description: 你好冒险家. 感谢来访.
为了确保{沃玛森林/Yellow}的安全,
我不得不向你们寻求帮助.
从{比奇城/Yellow}来的路上,
你可能已经见识到{食人花/Crimson}的厉害了.
我们需要消灭它们以确保来往商队的安全.
taskDescription: 从{食人花/Crimson}的尸体上收集1个{食人花茎/LightSteelBlue}和1个{食人花叶/LightSteelBlue},
并交给{沃玛森林/Yellow}的{Merchant 周涛/LimeGreen}.

sourceDescription: There have been icreasing numbers of
{SpittlingSpider's/Crimson} around the town. This monster
is poisonous and the antidote can only be made
from the {PoisonSack/LightSteelBlue}.
description: 村子附近的{毒蜘蛛/Crimson}越来越多,
这种怪物的剧毒的解毒剂只能通过{毒药袋/LightSteelBlue}来制作.
taskDescription: 消灭{毒蜘蛛/Crimson}并在它们的尸体上找到{毒药袋/LightSteelBlue}

sourceDescription: You came right on time. {MongchonScout/LimeGreen} came
by earlier and left a message for you. Please go
to the {Tavern/Yellow}
description: 你来的正好.
{MongchonEdwin/LimeGreen}刚才走的时候给你留了个口信儿.
请去{客栈/Yellow}找他吧,客栈就在比奇城的南城.
taskDescription: 去和{客栈/Yellow}的{MongchonEdwin/LimeGreen}谈谈.

sourceDescription: Hello traveller. You are quite famous around
here. Could you help me as well?
The demand for medicine has been increasing,
and we are short on the ingredients for the
medicine. We are especially short on {Web's/LightSteelBlue}
which can be found from {SpittingSpiders/Crimson} could you
please get some for me?
description: 你好旅行者,最近在这一带你真是远近闻名啊.
你能也帮我个忙吗?
随着战事越来越紧张,最近药品的需求不断增加,
但制作药品的材料却一直很短缺.
我们尤其需要的是{网/LightSteelBlue},
这玩意在{毒蜘蛛/Crimson}身上能搞到.
请帮我弄来一些好吗?
taskDescription: 在{毒蜘蛛/Crimson}身上收集5个{网/LightSteelBlue}.

sourceDescription: Can you please do me a favour. Can you
deliver these to {Bradly/LimeGreen} in {SerpentValley/Yellow}?
Hes ran out of {RepairOil's/LightSteelBlue}. But he needs them
to repair weapons. Please deliver them quickly.
description: 请帮我个忙.
你能帮我把这东西交给{毒蛇山谷/Yellow}的{李安/LimeGreen}吗?
他的{修复油/LightSteelBlue}用光了,但他却急需修理武器.
请尽快带给他,拜托了.
taskDescription: 把{修复油/LightSteelBlue}交给{李安/LimeGreen}.

sourceDescription: Hello traveller. I was returning to {SerpentValley/Yellow}
from {MongchonProvince/Yellow}. But I was attacked by
{Currish/Crimson} and dropped my bag. My priceless
{JadeRing/LightSteelBlue} was in the bag.
description: 你好冒险家,我在从{盟重省/Yellow}回{毒蛇山谷/Yellow}的路上
遭到了{恶狼/Crimson}的袭击,慌乱之中我的背包丢了,
我最珍贵的{翡翠戒指/LightSteelBlue}还在包里.
你能帮我找回来吗?
taskDescription: 在{恶狼/Crimson}身上找到{翡翠戒指/LightSteelBlue}.

sourceDescription: The Ring still look's perfect.
Please can you deliver the ring to my Daughter
{Melissa/LimeGreen}. She also requires some help.
description: 这戒指看起来还不错.
请你帮我把这个戒指带给我的女儿{郑勇/LimeGreen}.
她需要一些帮助.
taskDescription: 把{翡翠戒指/LightSteelBlue}带给{郑勇/LimeGreen}.

sourceDescription: Thankyou, I remember this Ring it used to
belong to my grandmother. Please take this Gift
back to {Bradly/LimeGreen} to show my gratitude.
description: 谢谢,我记得这个戒指还是我奶奶传下来的呢.
请将这个礼物带回给{李安/LimeGreen}以此表达我的谢意吧.
taskDescription: 将{蓝色药丸/LightSteelBlue}带回给{李安/LimeGreen}

sourceDescription: Please help me. I recently moved here, and i see
Snakes everywhere! I cant go to sleep knowing
the Snakes are crawling under my bed.
description: 请帮帮我. 这附近都是蛇,对于初来乍到的我实在不是一个好消息!
现在我被这些蛇弄得寝不安眠,似乎它们就在我的床下!
taskDescription: 猎杀5只{红蛇/Crimson} 和 {虎蛇/Crimson}.

sourceDescription: Are you going to {Bichon/Yellow} anytime soon? If you
go there, could you deliver this {SercetRecipe/LightSteelBlue}
to {CraftsLady/LimeGreen}? I hear the {CraftsLady/LimeGreen} in {Bichon/Yellow}
wants my {SecretRecipe/LightSteelBlue}. I'm too busy to go
there myself.
description: 你最近有回{比奇城/Yellow}的计划吗?
如果你有这个打算,能帮忙把{秘方/LightSteelBlue}带给{工艺夫人/LimeGreen}吗?
我听说{工艺夫人/LimeGreen}就在{比奇城/Yellow}
她很想要{秘方/LightSteelBlue},但我暂时走不开.
sourceTaskDescription: Please delivery this recipe to {CraftsLady/LimeGreen} in
taskDescription: 请将物品带给{比奇城/Yellow}的 {工艺夫人/LimeGreen}.

sourceDescription: Have you heard of {SnakeWine/LightSteelBlue}? This Wine is made
with {Red Snake/Crimson} and {Striped Snakes/Crimson}. I had this
once near the {SerpentValley/Yellow} and i still can't
forget the taste of it.
description: 你听说过{蛇酒/LightSteelBlue}吗?
这种酒是用{红蛇/Crimson}酿成的.
我曾经在{毒蛇山谷/Yellow}买到过一次,
至今回味无穷啊.
taskDescription: 请从{冯宁/LimeGreen}手里购买{蛇酒/LightSteelBlue}.

sourceDescription: I'm sorry but we are sold out of {SnakeWine/LightSteelBlue}.
I can make you some, But you will have to bring
me the ingredients.
description: 我很抱歉,{蛇酒/LightSteelBlue}卖光了.
我可以帮你酿一些,但是你得给我材料才行.
taskDescription: 从蛇身上收集5个{蛇躯/LightSteelBlue}.

sourceDescription: Here's the {SnakeWine/LightSteelBlue} for {MongchonScout/LimeGreen} as
promised. Please enjoy.
description: 这是酿好的{蛇酒/LightSteelBlue}.
请再辛苦一趟,把它带给{MongchonScout/LimeGreen}吧!
taskDescription: 带{蛇酒/LightSteelBlue}给{MongchonScout/LimeGreen}.

sourceDescription: Hello traveller. I also need some fruit to make
this wine. Could you get me 10 {EbonyFruit/LightSteelBlue}.
description: 你好旅行者.我还需要一些水果来酿酒.
你能帮我收集5{乌木果/LightSteelBlue}吗.
taskDescription: 收集5{乌木果/LightSteelBlue}

to visit him offen, but I've just been too busy.
Could you visit {MasterShok/LimeGreen} in {WoomyonWoods/Yellow}
and see how he's doing?
description: 我的祖父生活在{沃玛森林/Yellow}.
现在我太忙了,没有时间拜访他.
你能去帮我拜访{师父_冯静/LimeGreen}
看看他在忙些什么吗?
taskDescription: 拜访{师父_冯静/LimeGreen}
他的坐标在{沃玛森林/Yellow}的312:73

to {Woomyon Woods/Yellow} 40 years ago. I was able
to hunt all the monsters around my home then,
but now that I'm old and weak, I'm afraid to go
out of my house.
description: 你好旅行者.我搬来{沃玛森林/Yellow}已经40年了.
曾经,我努力猎杀着周围的怪物,
但现在我老了,干不动了,你能帮帮我吗?
taskDescription: 为{师父_冯静/LimeGreen}猎杀5只{半兽战士/Crimson}

sourceDescription: You remind me of my granschild. She went to
{Bichon/Yellow} to make money. I heard she was working
at a butcher's store. Could you let her know that
I'm doing well?
description: 你是受我孙女之托来的?
她去{比奇城/Yellow}赚钱了.
我听说她在肉店工作,
你能帮我回访一下她告诉她我的近况吗?
taskDescription: 与{冯慧/LimeGreen}交谈,她就在{比奇城/Yellow}肉店.

sourceDescription: Hello young Mirian, I'm planning going to
{MongchonProvince/Yellow} frequently, but i haven't left
this town because of the snake on the way.
Do you think you can eliminate some of those
snakes?
description: 你好旅行者,我最近正在计划前往{盟重省/Yellow},
但是我听说路上不是很太平,
你能帮我杀一些蛇吗?
taskDescription: 消灭5{赤色毒蛇/Crimson}和{斑纹虎蛇/Crimson}

sourceDescription: Do you know where {SerpentValley/Yellow} is? It's a
small town northwest of here. {Robert/LimeGreen} in that
town is looking for some help.
Are you interested?
description: 你知道{毒蛇山谷/Yellow}在哪吗?
这个小村子在我们的西北方.
{冯宁/LimeGreen}正在寻求一些帮助.
你有兴趣去一趟吗?
taskDescription: 与{冯宁/LimeGreen}交谈,他就在{毒蛇山谷/Yellow}

sourceDescription: Did you come to help me? Are you really going to
help? Thank you so much. I never settle at one
place, so I never have any neighbors to help me.
My daugther got bitten by a {RedSnake/Crimson} and the
poison is almost killing her. I heard there is a
famous doctor, {Sandford/LimeGreen} in {PrajnaIsland/Yellow}.
description: 你是来帮我的吗?这是真的吗?
太谢谢你了.我很少出门,也没什么邻居.
我女儿被{红蛇/Crimson}袭击了,蛇毒深入骨髓.
我听说有一个著名的医生,
他叫{冯强/LimeGreen}就住在{苍月岛/Yellow}.
sourceTaskDescription: Please visit {Sandford/LimeGreen} and retrieve the cure my
taskDescription: 拜访{冯强/LimeGreen}来挽救她的女儿

sourceDescription: {RedSnake/Crimson} bite? Please tell {Robert/LimeGreen} that the Teeth
of the {RedSnake/Crimson} is the main ingredient for the
cure. You don't have much time. Go and kill some
{RedSnake's/Crimson} for the Teeth.
description: {红蛇/Crimson}咬伤?
请转告{冯宁/LimeGreen}那些{红蛇/Crimson}的毒牙可以辅助治疗.
现在时间紧急,你快去杀一些{红蛇/Crimson}收集点毒牙.
taskDescription: 收集{红蛇牙/LightSteelBlue}

sourceDescription: {OmaCave/Yellow} are located in the west part of
{BichonProvince/Yellow}. This cave is filled with strong
monsters. It's very dark and almost like a maze
inside. Do you think you are ready to show your
courage?
description: {天然洞穴/Yellow}位于{比奇省/Yellow}西部.
这个洞穴里有很多厉害的怪物.
那里好似一个黑暗的迷宫.
你准备好去那里冒险了吗?
taskDescription: 在{天然洞穴/Yellow}猎杀{骷髅/Crimson}
并收集5个{骷髅骨/LightSteelBlue}

sourceDescription: Hello traveller, I have a favor tou ask you. I lost
my sister's ring while hunting in {OmaCave/Yellow}.
description: 你好,旅行者,我有个小小的请求.
我在{天然洞穴/Yellow}冒险时把妹妹的戒指遗失了,
请帮我找回来好吗!（需要在洞蛆身上挖取）
taskDescription: 在{天然洞穴/Yellow}找到{水晶戒指/LightSteelBlue}

sourceDescription: The {Border village/Yellow} is in trouble! More guards are
getting injured with frequent attacks from
monsters. {Ruben/LimeGreen} asked for {Relics/LightSteelBlue} for the injured.
description: {边界村/Yellow}遇到大麻烦了!
越来越多的守卫投入到了保卫战之中,伤亡惨重.
{我/LimeGreen}现在急需要一些{遗物/LightSteelBlue}去治疗他们.
taskDescription: 猎杀{洞蛆/Crimson}收集5个{遗物/LightSteelBlue}

sourceDescription: Have you been to the dungeon near {Bichon/Yellow}?
The {Skeletons/Crimson} are there. The Guard near the
dungeon reported that the number of {Skeletons/Crimson}
have been increasing lately. Do you think you
can go eliminate 25 {Skeletons/Crimson}? This is for the
safety of {Bichon/Yellow}.
description: 你感受到离{比奇城/Yellow}越来越近的危险了吗?
{骷髅军团/Crimson}就要入侵了.
我们的探报说{骷髅/Crimson}的数量不断的在增加.
你能猎杀他们并收集一些{骷髅/Crimson}来嘛?
这样会让{比奇省/Yellow}更加安全.
taskDescription: 猎杀10只{骷髅/Crimson}

sourceDescription: Do you know how to get to {CastleGi-Ryoong/Yellow}? I
need to send a CookBook to {Butcher Jim/LimeGreen} in
{CastleGi-Ryoong/Yellow}?
description: 你知道怎么去{封魔谷/Yellow}吗?
我想送一本菜谱给封魔谷的{ButcherJim/LimeGreen}.
taskDescription: 前往{沃玛森林/Yellow}的北方,
将{菜谱/LightSteelBlue}带给{封魔谷/Yellow}的{吴宁/LimeGreen}

sourceDescription: Do you know of {CanniTea?/LightSteelBlue} Its the best Tea
ever. I want to have some, but it's not easy
to get. Could you ask {CraftLady/LimeGreen} to
make some {CanniTea/LightSteelBlue} for me?
description: 你知道{食人花茶/LightSteelBlue}吗?那是这片大陆上最好的茶.
我想弄一些来,但是这可不是件容易事儿.
你能向{工艺夫人/LimeGreen}要一杯{食人花茶/LightSteelBlue}给我吗?

sourceDescription: Did you want me to make you {CanniTea/LightSteelBlue}? Hmm..
I ran out of Ingredients. Do you think you can
get me 10 {CannibalLeaf/LightSteelBlue} and 10 {CannibalSeed/LightSteelBlue}?
description: 你想让我帮你做{食人花茶/LightSteelBlue}?嗯..
我需要一些原料.
你能帮我找到1个{食人花叶/LightSteelBlue}和1个{食人花果实/LightSteelBlue}吗?
taskDescription: 从{食人花/Crimson}身上收集{食人花叶/LightSteelBlue}和{食人花果实/LightSteelBlue}各1个

sourceDescription: Here is the Tea you asked for. Please deliver this
before it gets cold.
description: 这是你需要的茶,快些喝吧,别凉了.
taskDescription: 将{食人花茶/LightSteelBlue}带给{MirGuide/LimeGreen}

sourceDescription: The materials I need for making weapons
can be found in {DeadMineEntrance/Yellow}, but the area
is infested with {Zombies/Crimson}.
description: 我需要一些打造武器的材料,
{废矿/Yellow}里就有这种材料,
但是那里被{僵尸/Crimson}占领了.
taskDescription: 前往{废矿/Yellow}猎杀{僵尸/Crimson}.

sourceDescription: Could you please help me. I need to restock my
supplies. Could you please find the materials
from the {Caves/Yellow} near {Bichon/Yellow}?
description: 快帮帮我.我需要充实我的货源.
你能帮我找一些材料吗?
它们在{比奇省/Yellow}附近山洞中的怪物手里.
taskDescription: 在{天然洞穴/Yellow}收集5个{蝙蝠牙/LightSteelBlue}和{骷髅头/LightSteelBlue},
